en.name: Blackjack
en.description: Blackjack tables where members play against the dealer for chips. Chips are not money: they cannot be bought or cashed out, and everyone below 1,000 is topped up to 1,000 each day.
en.retention: Keeps each table's current round until the next one starts, and each member's chips in each community until their account is deleted.
en.notMoney: Chips are for fun: they cannot be bought or cashed out. Below 1,000, you are topped up to 1,000 each day.
en.waitingForDeal: Dealing in %{seconds} s, or when everyone seated presses Deal now.
en.waitingForBets: Place a bet to start the round.
en.nextRound: Place a bet to play the next round.
en.notNow: That cannot be done at this point in the round.
en.seated: You already have a bet on this round.
en.notSeated: You have no bet on this round.
en.tableFull: Every seat at this table is taken. Wait for the next round, or try another table.
en.betRange: A bet is 10 to 500 chips, in steps of 10.
en.cannotDouble: A hand can be doubled only on its first two cards.
en.cannotSplit: Only a first pair of equal value can be split, once.
en.stale: The table changed before your choice arrived. Look again and choose.
en.busy: The table is still settling earlier rounds. Try again in a moment.
en.notEnoughChips: You do not have enough chips for that.
en.cannotPlay: You can watch this table, but not play at it: you cannot send messages here.
en.notFound: This table could not be found.
en.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
